QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] The Last Resort
QuestInfo.0: It appears #bScion#k found a way to exist even without its central mainframe. How can you root out the malicious AI now?
QuestInfo.2: Pressed by #bSpencer#k, #bKrania#k eventually revealed the existence of a secret #rself-destruct system#k that, if activated, would blow the entire Aspire facility to smithereens, destroying all traces of #bScion#k.
